patterns.note: Colossal, screen-spanning hero typography layered behind hyper-realistic 3D assets to establish immediate visual depth.
Scroll-driven parallax where foreground 3D elements float and rotate at a different speed than the massive background text layers.
Extreme contrast between giant, heavy-weight display sans-serif headings and tiny, widely-spaced metadata tags.
Rounded, dark-themed container blocks that group service details and brand pillars, contrasting against the ultra-light page background.

technique_notes: To recreate the depth effect, layer a high-resolution transparent 3D render (or live WebGL canvas) directly over a container containing absolute-positioned, viewport-width-scaled text. Apply a subtle scroll-bound CSS transform (translateY and slight rotation) to the 3D asset to make it feel detached and floating relative to the text behind it.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extreme scale contrast with massive display headers (120px+) paired with small, clean body text (14px-16px) and tiny uppercase labels.

standout: The integration of hyper-detailed, industrial 3D mechanical models that physically overlap giant, minimalist typography, creating a striking tension between clean Swiss graphic design and gritty, futuristic hardware.
